 "rationale": "Branch current is about 0.4 uA. The design uses three branches plus a leak-only start-up, so total current is about 1.3 uA (about 2.4 uW). A PTAT core sets I = UT·ln8/R1. The output branch gives vref = R3/(R2+R3)·(Veb + I·R2), where I·R2 is chosen to cancel the Veb slope; this scales the about 1.25 V bandgap down to 0.95 V. Long-L mirrors keep line regulation low, and C(vdd–pg) improves PSRR. An inverter on vref pulls pg low while vref is low."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (0.4e-6, 0.2e-6, 0.7e-6),   # core branch current (PTAT)
    "gmid_n": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),         # NMOS level-shift pair, deep subthreshold (low Vgs)
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (15.0, 10.0, 16.0),         # PMOS mirror, high gm/Id -> Vsg below |Vth| for headroom
    "Lp":     (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),
    "tc_trim":(1.0, 0.8, 1.25),           # multiplies R2 (TC trim)
    "vtgt":   (0.95, 0.93, 0.97),         # vref target (sets divider R3)
    "Cpg":    (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 8e-12),    # vdd-to-pg cap for PSRR
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]
    N = 8          # Q2/Q1 area ratio
    mq1 = 2        # Q1 multiplicity (lower current density -> lower Veb, more headroom)
    T0 = 300.15

    def veb(i, m):   # PNP Veb model: 0.76 V at 10 uA per unit
        return 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / (10e-6 * m))

    # ---- PTAT core ----
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I

    # NMOS level-shift pair (identical devices, sources at ~Veb -> body effect cancels)
    veb1 = veb(I, mq1)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=veb1)
    # PMOS mirror (M1, M2, M5 identical: same L and gm/Id)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.6)

    # ---- output stage: vref = Rp*(I + Veb3/R2), Rp = R2||R3 ----
    # TC condition: I*R2/T = -dVeb3/dT, dVeb/dT ~ (Veb - Vg0 - 3UT)/T
    Io = I
    vt = p["vtgt"]
    Iq = 0.5 * Io
    R2 = R3 = 1e6
    for _ in range(20):
        v3 = veb(Iq, 1)
        dveb = (v3 - 1.2 - 3 * UT) / T0          # V/K (negative)
        R2 = p["tc_trim"] * (-dveb) * T0 / Io
        vbg = v3 + Io * R2
        k = vt / vbg                              # = R3/(R2+R3)
        k = min(max(k, 0.3), 0.98)
        R3 = k * R2 / (1 - k)
        Iq = max(Io - vt / R3, 0.02e-6)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Io, vds=1.8 - vt)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # branch 1: M1 -> NMOS diode M3 -> Q1
    n.dev("M1", "na", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M3", "na", "na", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=mq1)
    # branch 2: PMOS diode M2 -> M4 -> R1 -> Q2 (N x)
    n.dev("M2", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "pg", "na", "x", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "x", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=mq1 * N)
    # output branch: M5 -> vref; R3 to vss, R2+Q3 to vss
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    # PSRR: make the PMOS gate track vdd
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", p["Cpg"])

    # ---- start-up: inverter senses vref; when vref low, sx high -> Ms pulls pg low ----
    n.M("Msp", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)   # weak pull-up (off when vref~0.95)
    n.M("Msn", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)     # strong pull-down
    n.M("Ms",  "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)      # kick device

    # ---- predictions ----
    v3 = veb(Iq, 1)
    vref_pred = (R3 / (R2 + R3)) * (v3 + Io * R2)
    i_total = 3 * I + 0.05e-6
    power = 1.8 * i_total
    # line reg: output mirror channel-length modulation dominates
    lam = mp.gds / max(mp.Id, 1e-15)
    rp = R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    line_reg = lam * Io * rp + 0.005
    psrr = -db(max(line_reg, 1e-4))
    return n, {
        "vref": vref_pred,
        "tc_ppm": 80.0,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "power": power,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
